analysis:
In its 2009 year-end review, the Ministry of Human Resource Development stated that an independent 2009 study showed out-of-school children had declined to 4.22% of the 6-14 age group.

The same government exercise, and a separate PIB release, attribute the underlying finding to a 2009 sample survey by SRI-IMRB that counted about 80 lakh out-of-school children in that age band. The percentage and the absolute number are consistent with each other for the relevant child population.

Later government surveys and the 2011 Census reported continued declines in out-of-school children, so the direction of the claim is supported by later data.
notes: The statement is a Ministry/PIB release rather than a direct ministerial quote; it is attributed here to the HRD Minister who led the ministry.
